skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the worldview and scientific methodology of Marxist-Leninist philosophy.
Grasp the fundamental concepts of dialectical materialism.
Comprehend the dialectical method and its application in understanding reality.
Understand the laws governing social movement and development.
Develop logical thinking skills for analyzing and solving problems scientifically.
Demonstrate ability to work individually and in groups on economic, political, and social issues.
Become a responsible global citizen with a sense of social responsibility.
Show initiative in learning, research, and group work.
